summary: Had another idea. At @IndieWebCamp Berlin @sonniesedge proposed using the property attribute from RDFa for microformats rather than class attribute. So many themes or plugins style classes or use the p- and u- prefix in CSS... Will ask in chat of worth playing.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Had another idea. At @IndieWebCamp Berlin @sonniesedge proposed using the property attribute from RDFa for microformats rather than class attribute.

So many themes or plugins style classes or use the p- and u- prefix in CSS... Will ask in chat of worth playing.
